acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode using the Top-speed setting with 2 s cycle time.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: alkylated with 0.05 M iodoacetamide in 8 M urea in 0.1 M Tris*HCl, pH 8.5 and washed again

alkylation_reagent.evidence: alkylated with 0.05 M iodoacetamide in 8 M urea in 0.1 M Tris*HCl, pH 8.5 and washed again

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was added at a protein-to-trypsin (m/m) ratio of 50:1 and digested for 18 h at 30°C.

collision_energy.evidence: Precursor ions passing a 5e3 intensity cut-off and fulfilling monoisotopic precursors filter with z = 2-6+ were selected for fragmentation by higher-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) with 30% normalized collision energy (NCE) followed by detection in the Ion trap operated in rapid scan mode at a maximum injection time setting of “dynamic” and the normalized AGC target set to 200%.
